review.reviewer: Codex integration owner; independent source and mapping review by gtmux %20
review.decision: Reviewed for separate integration from the frozen source; device acceptance remains outstanding
review.notes: This is a truthful retrospective review of work already implemented before main introduced this gate. It does not claim prior review or passing device behavior. Cold and warm actions, real fold and accessibility remain subject to recorded evidence. On 2026-11-05 the cold-action trace exposed drain-before-JS-ack loss; DUO-009 was reviewed before implementing acknowledgement-based retention. Earlier prototype tests remain honestly retrospective. DUO-010 was updated after observing a native drain Promise stall; its non-blocking fallback and foreground recovery are reviewed before implementation. Permission-wait ordering was implemented during diagnosis; its specific regression test was reviewed afterwards and must not be represented as a pre-implementation review. DUO-018 and DUO-019 describe tests reviewed retrospectively after implementation; the new integration review must precede the actual migration. DUO-020 and subsequent driver/suite adjustments are retrospective WIP, not evidence of an earlier review or of a completed fold test. DUO-021 is recorded after its initial WIP implementation; the integration review must precede migration. DUO-022 is recorded after its initial WIP implementation; the integration review must precede migration. DUO-023 is recorded after initial WIP implementation; the integration review must precede migration. DUO-024 and strengthened DUO-010/019 tests are retrospectively recorded WIP; integration review must precede migration. DUO-024 active-state concurrent recovery assertions were added after WIP implementation, pending actual integration review. Duo posture tests wait at most 20 seconds for the measured hinge to reach the requested angle, per the driver 12.20 documentation; screenshots do not alone establish posture. DUO-002 now checks the unique session title after rotation; Duo posture tests wait for a stable observable window or visible modal control frame before asserting state, recorded retrospectively. DUO-025 records the compact navigation preservation fix and regression after WIP implementation; review must precede separate integration. DUO-026 and the DUO-023 outer-panel menu check are recorded after WIP implementation and require review before integration. Integration preparation from PR1810-derived local source cae4c446f3a5cfc8d8cca899d6f7eb9e5aaaf846 onto main 50fd32738d5f5171629a16d1f93e55aedc5d6a4c; this draft is not a review or evidence that original implementation was reviewed in advance. DUO-007 request-diagnostics.test.ts verifies the additional side-channel diagnostics in startFake (mobileapp/e2e/fake-serve/server.ts); the existing CT-HTTP contract remains intact and continues to map startFake. Independent review of frozen Q cae4c446f3a5cfc8d8cca899d6f7eb9e5aaaf846 against B 50fd32738d5f5171629a16d1f93e55aedc5d6a4c concluded with relay c04db94cf9a846c4a2095d3feb0e56c2 after review of earlier source stages and the final delta. The original implementation predates this integration review; this record precedes its separate migration only. Device, candidate and main checks remain outstanding. Follow-up review after run 42047638915: DUO-008 will verify a bounded hosted-only Appium idle lifetime long enough to retain a session during slow simulator preparation, with preparation timing diagnostics. DUO-001 retains its banner-tap assertion and captures the actual system surface when that assertion fails. No product wait or behavior assertion is relaxed; the cause of slow preparation and missing banner remains to be measured. The case objects retain their original reviewed behavior; the separately reviewed diagnostic follow-up above adds evidence without changing those initial acceptance criteria. Follow-up review from a055 simulator evidence: the outer 466pt root contained a 382pt workspace reader and 298pt detail chat because the shell and detail each apply a horizontal safe-area edge. Give each visible screen responsibility for its own outer horizontal inset, protect the regular sidebar and its reveal control separately, and exercise compact and regular state retention. Fold-reading identity must be checked after preserving the visible scroll anchor and revealing the intentionally auto-hidden header; the large-text scenario must navigate from any previous reader back to the list before selecting its session. Preserve all fold, identity, draft, interaction and accessibility assertions. The device remains to be retested. Independent Appium Duo guidance states hinge changes do not select a display and currentDisplayId controls screenshots and W3C actions. The a055 log reset that setting to null after unfolding, then notification long presses targeted the default outer display while screenshots were black. Each independent unfolded Duo scene/rotation case must explicitly measure angle, enumerate displays and select the inner display before actions, retaining all existing behavioral assertions; screenshots and actual native action evidence remain required. Follow-up review of run 42071592214: retain the native SafeAreaView root with no edges so iPad accessibility keeps radar-split visible without reapplying horizontal insets. While a chat reader is away from the live tail, use React Native maintainVisibleContentPosition to keep its first visible turn through content reflow; retain existing live-tail pinning, and verify the actual first visible message across fold. Verify Trace input has the exact intended text before folding, then assert it persists. Preserve all product behavior assertions and keep audit, scene-link and rotation failures visible. Run 42071592214 timed out the complete multi-step Duo rotation journey at Jest 120s while its outstanding WebDriver operation continued into the following scene-link case. Give that complete journey the same bounded 300s budget already used by the fold journey; individual waits, rotation, draft and session assertions remain unchanged. Native driver errors and any true product failures remain failures. In the large-text case, collect both display interactions and attempt each native accessibility audit even if the first audit errors; persist each error and fail the case afterward. Neither audit error nor missing interaction is counted as success. Run 42086224588 delivered a warm scene URL natively but the existing RN one-shot event did not reach JS. For recognized gtmux usage URLs, enqueue each scene delivery with an ID before notifying the visual consumer through a native event; drain and acknowledge once, retry after a missing listener or foreground transition, and keep other URLs on the RN route. Preserve guest/demo rejection and distinct repeated user intents. Native queue/signal checks and a fresh JS event test precede further device validation. Run 42086224588 showed a visible history prompt moved offscreen on fold despite the native anchor. Before width reflow, record a fully visible conversation turn and its viewport offset; restore that turn as its measured layout shifts, cancel on new user gesture, and never interrupt live-tail following or active text selection. Device reflow remains required. The outer accessibility audit also identified a small back hit region; make its measured target at least 44 points without changing its action. Run 42086224588 left WDA reporting the app not running after the warm background transition failed; the next rotation test queried orientation before launching its own app, so it did not execute its journey. Launch that test fixture before capturing orientation, preserve the warm failure and all rotation/keyboard/session assertions, and restore only an orientation actually captured.

cases.description: native notification response queue retains a drained response until JS acknowledges it, while preserving identity, action, text, bounds and duplicate suppression
cases.setup: A Foundation-only native fixture with distinct response identifiers, numbered action and text; no user data or device connection.
cases.action: Enqueue duplicate and distinct responses, inspect the same pending response twice without acknowledgement, acknowledge it, then exceed the bounded queue capacity.
cases.expected: Unacknowledged responses remain retrievable; acknowledged responses disappear, duplicate identity/action is queued once, and only the newest 128 entries remain.
surfaces: iOS Duo adaptation and ordinary-device regression

cases.description: a stalled native notification drain must not block the initial notification fallback, and foreground recovery retries retained responses without duplicate replies
cases.setup: Mock a native drain Promise that never resolves, an initial notification and an app-state listener; also hold a separate permission Promise pending. Use identified responses and a fake reply callback.
cases.action: Start push setup with the first drain pending, observe initial fallback, simulate foreground activation and a duplicate native response, and check a pending permission request separately.
cases.expected: Initial fallback proceeds despite a stalled drain or permission request, foreground retry retrieves a retained response, and shared identity permits at most one reply. If the initial notification is absent and the first drain stalls, a later active transition delivers and acknowledges the retained response once.
surfaces: iOS Duo adaptation and ordinary-device regression

cases.description: Notification bootstrap runs before native safe-area metrics arrive
cases.setup: React Native renderer with isolated dependencies; the inset gate uses the installed provider implementation.
cases.action: Render the real JS safe-area provider without native insets, then deliver a measured inset event. Render the actual app with a ready identity and verify its push bridge starts with no native inset event.
cases.expected: Background handling starts before the event; the visual tree starts after it without remounting background handling.
surfaces: iOS Duo adaptation and ordinary-device regression

cases.description: Widget URL listener stays registered across connection and guest state changes
cases.setup: React Native renderer with isolated dependencies; the inset gate uses the installed provider implementation.
cases.action: Change the current connection or guest state while delivering widget links.
cases.expected: One listener stays active, uses current owner state, and guest or parameterized links remain rejected. Changing the client retains one listener and uses its latest client; a guest-rejected link cannot open after switching to owner.
surfaces: iOS Duo adaptation and ordinary-device regression

cases.description: The Duo simulator preserves selected conversation, reading state and input draft over real hinge changes
cases.setup: Named iOS 27.1 Duo simulator and isolated Appium XCUITest 12.20.0/WDA 16.17.1; fake server with long chat; no physical-device claim.
cases.action: Enumerate displays, measure hinge, interact with a long conversation and keyboard, close and reopen the simulator hinge, select each reported panel and capture screenshots.
cases.expected: Measured hinge reaches open and closed positions, the application window changes, the selected conversation and the same visible reading prompt survive, and the typed draft remains after fold and unfold.
surfaces: iPhone Duo simulator; physical-device and accessibility checks remain separate

cases.description: Trace search and Diff survive Duo simulator posture changes
cases.setup: Named iOS 27.1 Duo simulator, supported isolated driver and fake server with transcript and synthetic diff.
cases.action: Open the selected session Trace, enter a search, fold and unfold, then open Diff and repeat the posture transitions.
cases.expected: Trace keeps its selected session and search text; Diff remains open and both can be exited after posture changes.
surfaces: iPhone Duo simulator; physical-device and accessibility checks remain separate

cases.description: Cold scene activity includes the type and original activity expected by React Native
cases.setup: Standalone native Swift check with a synthetic browsing activity and URL.
cases.action: Build the scene launch dictionary through the same helper called by SceneDelegate.
cases.expected: The dictionary includes the browsing activity type under the supplied UIKit key and retains the original activity and URL; actual UIKit delivery remains a device test.
surfaces: iOS scene cold links

cases.description: Duo panels retain session and tools access at an enlarged accessibility text size
cases.setup: Named Duo simulator, supported isolated Appium driver, fake server; remember and restore the simulator text size.
cases.action: Set accessibility-large, use the session row on the folded panel, unfold and open the session tools; record screenshots and XCTest accessibility audit findings for each panel.
cases.expected: The size setting reports accessibility-large and the selected session and tools are reachable on both panels; save actual audit findings without claiming a VoiceOver or physical-device pass.
surfaces: Duo simulator text sizing and automated accessibility audit

cases.description: Scene links arriving after headless React starts survive until the visual consumer is ready
cases.setup: Native Swift synthetic scene inputs and a React consumer with a controlled native buffer; no UIKit device lifecycle is claimed.
cases.action: Queue URL contexts and browsing activities, drain before acknowledgment, mount the visual consumer, reject a guest link and retry an initially failed drain on foreground.
cases.expected: Scene URLs remain pending until acknowledged, the consumer opens an authorized usage link once, guest-rejected links do not become later owner intents, and foreground retry can recover the retained link. A stalled first drain cannot block active-state recovery, and a later duplicate is suppressed.
surfaces: iOS scene link handoff and app usage entry

cases.description: Compact list or reader navigation survives an expansion and fold
cases.setup: Rendered adaptive workspace with a selected synthetic session and controllable size class.
cases.action: Return from the selected reader to the compact list, expand and fold; separately select a session while expanded and fold.
cases.expected: The previously visible compact list returns after a round trip; an explicit expanded selection opens its reader, and a first wide automatic selection still shows its reader on folding.
surfaces: iPhone adaptive navigation and iPad compatibility

cases.description: A rejected initial usage link cannot replay after guest or demo mode changes
cases.setup: Separate isolated Jest test files start with fresh initial-link module state and guest or demo connections.
cases.action: Resolve the initial usage URL while guest or demo, then switch to owner without another URL.
cases.expected: A guest- or demo-rejected initial intent is consumed once; no sheet opens or usage request occurs after the owner transition.
surfaces: iOS initial link and cross-connection state

cases.description: A history reader keeps a native visible-content anchor without changing live-tail following
cases.setup: Render a conversation at the live tail, then simulate a user drag into history and a return to the tail.
cases.action: Exercise the chat ScrollView scroll callbacks and inspect the native anchor configuration after each user state transition.
cases.expected: The native visible-content anchor is active only while reading history; live-tail following stays active at the tail. Actual reflow is separately verified on the Duo simulator.
surfaces: iOS Duo adaptation and ordinary-device regression

cases.description: A warm scene usage intent survives a missed event and is consumed once by the visual bridge
cases.setup: A native scene-link queue contains uniquely identified usage intents; the visual consumer subscribes and may transition between guest and owner.
cases.action: Deliver native availability events, including repeated events and a rejected guest intent, and inspect acknowledgements and sheet behavior.
cases.expected: Each queued intent is acknowledged once, a repeated availability event cannot reopen a consumed intent, guest rejection does not replay on owner, and unrelated URLs keep their normal routing. Native signal and actual scene delivery require separate checks.
surfaces: iOS scene links and ordinary-device regression

cases.description: A history reader retains a visible turn while the window width reflows
cases.setup: Render a conversation with measured turn positions, a history scroll offset, and a controllable window size.
cases.action: Change width, update the anchored turn layout in multiple increments, then exercise user interruption and live-tail behavior.
cases.expected: A fully visible turn remains at its prior viewport position across measured reflow; user gestures and active selection are not overridden and the tail continues following. Actual fold remains independently verified on Duo.
surfaces: Duo history reflow and ordinary-device compatibility
